# CF-005: The origin IP does not answer on 80/443 from outside (probe)

- **Group:** Cloudflare Tunnel
- **Severity when it fails:** high
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

Only an outside view proves an origin bypass: the host cannot see its provider firewall. `stackward probe` connects to the origin address from another machine; an answer on 80/443 while the tunnel is the ingress means the WAF can be skipped.

## Verify by hand

```sh
stackward probe <origin-ip> from a machine outside the provider network
```

## How to fix it

See CF-003: bind the proxy to loopback and close 80/443 in the provider firewall

Run `stackward explain CF-005` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
